mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 206.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering market uncertainty and negative 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 206.0, or returns revert to baseline within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS alongside falling UNRATE signals contractionary policy, reducing growth expectations and generating negative 20-day returns through risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% while UNRATE falls > 0.1% over 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling does not occur, yet 20-day returns are negative, or returns are positive when the interaction is present.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, simultaneous growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) suggests market overvaluation, leading to negative returns as investors anticipate corrections.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day returns are not negative when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or returns are positive despite the overvaluation signal.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 reflects strong corporate demand, boosting earnings expectations and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises but 20-day returns do not show a statistically significant positive relationship (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS crossing above 138,000 signals robust labor market strength, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 138,000 but 20-day returns are not significantly positive, or returns revert within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Both RSAFS and HOUST surging indicates unsustainable demand growth, prompting market pullbacks and negative 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: both RSAFS and HOUST rise > 5% over 3 months
failure_condition: The RSAFS and HOUST interaction (both rising) does not occur, yet 20-day returns are negative, or returns are positive when the interaction is present.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery, rising RSAFS and HOUST reflect improving demand, supporting positive 20-day returns as markets anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery, 20-day returns are not positive when RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or returns revert to baseline within 60 days.
